blocks.text: Every web page should have a page title to describe the meaning of the page.

The <title> element adds a title
to your page:

<!DOCTYPE html>

<html>
<head>

<title>HTML Tutorial</title>

 </head>

<body>

The content of the document......

</body>

</html>
blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: The title should describe the content and the meaning of the page.

The page title is very important for search engine optimization
(SEO). The text is used by search engine algorithms to decide the order
when listing pages in search results.

items: defines a title in the browser toolbar
provides a title for the page when it is added to favorites
displays a title for the page in search engine-results

blocks.text: So, try to make the title as accurate and meaningful as possible!
